mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 46 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park.

The city has announced pavement repairs beginning November 10 near North Nine Mound Road and other areas, with paving to follow on November 11. Additionally, the Plan Commission will meet on December 7 to discuss pending projects including a development at Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmer's Market happening today, along with live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Paddy Mac's this coming Tuesday.
A noteworthy call from the weekly report occurred on October 25, when officers arrested a man for O W I after he was discovered stationary at a street intersection.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Really Reese's. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight.
